Class UiThemes

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.UiThemes
public final class UiThemes extends Object
Client theme selection and scoped color lookup. A widget's menu and path travel with its draw call, including detached windows. Drawing one menu cannot leave its overrides active in another menu.
